rulings.quote: we performed a meta-analysis of European-ancestry genome-wide association studies in 128,681 cases or proxy cases of ADRD and 849,833 (proxy) controls.
rulings.reasoning: The readings count different things: 128,681 is the case/proxy-case total and 978,514 is the cases-plus-controls sum (which the document never states as such). The document additionally reports a rough effective sample size of 230,631, so no bare number can stand unlabelled.

rulings.correct_value: European-ancestry participants from 52 studies: clinically diagnosed AD cases, biobank cases identified by International Classification of Diseases codes, and proxy ADRD cases (individuals reporting at least one biological relative, parent or sibling, affected with dementia), plus controls and proxy controls
rulings.quote: The meta-analysis included 72,721 AD cases, 55,960 proxy ADRD cases, 614,267 controls and 235,566 proxy controls from 52 studies, corresponding to a rough effective sample size of 230,631
rulings.reasoning: Both describe the same population at different resolutions; reading B echoes one clause of the Main text and omits deCODE and HUNT, the 52 studies, and the case/control composition, all of which the document states. Reading A is fully supported and more precise.

rulings.quote: To better characterize the genetic architecture and pathophysiology underlying AD and ADRD, we joined efforts across the three consortia to perform a consensus meta-analysis of ADRD GWAS across all our samples of European ancestry, the UK Biobank (UKBB) and FinnGen.
rulings.reasoning: The document contains no registration, protocol or statement that any outcome was specified in advance; it describes a hypothesis-free genome-wide discovery meta-analysis with post hoc sensitivity and tier classifications. 'Unclear' is what the document supports.
